status_summary: Executive Order 14335 (signed 2025-08-13) directed the Commerce Secretary to elevate the Office of Space Commerce into the Office of the Secretary within 60 days and to propose a process for individualized mission authorizations of novel space activities within 150 days. The Office of Space Commerce released a proposed Space Commerce Certification framework in March 2026 and on 2026-08-20 published a notice seeking expressions of interest (due 2026-10-05) in a voluntary pilot; the notice says a certification issued in the pilot carries no legal effect by itself and that participants must still meet existing FCC and FAA licensing requirements. The August 2026 notice was issued under NOAA and still describes the office as part of NOAA, and no document confirming the move to the Office of the Secretary was found, so neither directive is yet operative. The order does not mention the National Space Council, which the Mandate named.

timeline.event: President signs Executive Order 14335, Enabling Competition in the Commercial Space Industry (90 FR 40219, published 2025-08-19). Section 6(b) directs elevation of the Office of Space Commerce into the Office of the Secretary within 60 days; Section 5 directs Commerce to propose a mission-authorization process for novel space activities within 150 days.

The Office of Space Commerce posts that the order directs the elevation, which would take the office out of NOAA, where it was then located, so that it reports to the top level of the department; the post does not say the move was done.

Commerce publishes a Notice of Mission Authorization Pilot Program under Section 5 of the order (91 FR 53849), seeking expressions of interest by 2026-10-05 and stating that the Space Commerce Certification framework was first released in March 2026; participation is voluntary and the notice places the Office of Space Commerce within NOAA.

title: Elevate the Office of Space Commerce and set a unified commercial space licensing policy
uncertainties: Whether the Office of Space Commerce has actually been moved into the Office of the Secretary could not be confirmed: the August 2026 Federal Register notice (dated 2026-08-18, issued under NOAA) lists the office within NOAA, the office's own pages reviewed do not state its placement, and one search for an order or announcement of the move returned only coverage of the executive order itself. A Department Organization Order could exist that was not found. The March 2026 certification framework proposal was described only through the August notice; its text was not read. The order does not mention the National Space Council; the Council's current role was not checked. A Federal Register search for the office since 2025-01-20 showed the order, the notice and routine information-collection notices.
